row.notes: lea rdx,["?"]: default of the block-name bound cmp dl,0x11 ; ja (type 0..17 named through k_Career_UpgradeBlockNameTable, rdx = block name at the join). rnd-tyres sets rdx = its block name for 19..22 and jumps to the join

signature.data1_reason: the block-name bound and its default are inline in the .data1 body 0x14fa63050; no .xtls code names the block

verify.notes: V0085 cmp dl,0x11 ; ja 0x14fa6315f = lea rdx '?' (7 bytes) falling into join 0x14fa63166; 0..17 take rdx = table+table[dl] and jmp join; .xtls continuation 0x144742c70 only sees the name, so naming has no .xtls route
